systems.system: mobile data collection and digital registration systems (Scaling-Up Birth Registration Using Innovative Technology)
systems.owner: UNICEF Tanzania as grant recipient; the operating agency is not named
systems.tiers: not stated; target of 7 million children under five

note: A grant record: Global Affairs Canada committed CAD 30,650,000 (US$23,968,300) to UNICEF Tanzania, 2015 to 2023, fully disbursed, to register and issue birth certificates to 7 million under-fives using mobile data collection and digital registration systems. It does not say where or by whom the digital record is made, so the system is left unclassified and no fact is taken; if the parent classes it civil from other documents, this is donor finance for it.
